scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but workable with substantial friction; 7 good with clear recurring friction; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional. Holistic judgments of observed content only; overall is not a computed average or win/loss grade.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent short combat/recovery mission with effective touch assists and clear milestones, offset by camera/threat management and dense landscape HUD. Both the loss and win informed friction; neither determines the grade.
reasons.controls: Tap aim, large fire target, hold route and native stick strafe worked. Two-thumb inputs are available, but combined route/fire was confusing and quick rear threat reacquisition took multiple swipes. Fine fire-drag and AIM slowdown were not meaningfully tested.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, enemy engagement, coil timing and extraction defense provided observed variety and a useful learning opportunity between attempts. Long bursts wasted ammo; offscreen pressure was difficult to manage. No claim about replay depth or unassessed content.
reasons.presentation: Rainy station, cyan/amber cues, typography and terminal layouts form a cohesive atmosphere. Visual judgment only; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, paused map, route/recovery assistance, explicit release cue, fresh restart and clear terminal stats are helpful. Route facing at extraction and uncertainty about blocked shots add friction. Settings were not changed.
reasons.readability: Core objectives, health, ammo and coil OFF states are clear. Small threat labels, terminal secondary stats and multiple overlays crowd 844x390; dark structures can obscure targets.

cleanup.conclusion: Both exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent. No process kill used.
